searchText: Some news on builders & relays: https://x.com/blockspaceforum/status/2100205968311148676 In terms of epbs, multiparty blocks are published as if from the ‘base’ builder it seems more likely that individual builders run by trading companies are more likely than relays to take the 'free option' route - why the assumption that relays will be doing this? I'm not assuming that relays will be doing this, just mentioning that the best mitigation I know for the usual builders on relays is that one. I'm unaware of any other mitigations at the moment
